explanation: The 2014-09-17 document contains substantive content including: (1) publication of a formal Monetary Policy Normalization Principles statement—a significant new framework disclosure; (2) a further $10B taper of asset purchases (to $15B/month total); (3) explicit forward guidance that QE would end at the 'next meeting'; and (4) expansion of the ON RRP counterparty cap from $10B to $30B with a $300B overall limit and introduction of an auction mechanism. The normalization principles release in particular represented a material regime-change signal about the Fed's exit strategy that could plausibly have caused a structural break in financial market data around September 25.
